name: How-it-works steps
definition: Three numbered steps in a row, each with a short title and one sentence, showing how a visitor gets from sign-up to result.
bestUse: Products whose setup or mechanism is unfamiliar and worries first-time visitors.

demo.how: Three steps make an unfamiliar product feel simple: each has a number, a verb-first title and one sentence on what happens. Play reveals the steps in order along the connecting line. More than four steps usually means the section is describing the product, not the path. The steps are illustrative.
